subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw require exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss stream proof before accepting any recovery path that could reclassify assistant text as executable tool calls?
rationale: The proposed recovery behavior affects the tool-execution boundary, and current source already covers the reduced structured reasoning-before-tool_calls shape, so maintainers need to set the evidence bar before sponsoring a broader or provider-specific recovery.

options.title: Require exact stream proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

options.title: Sponsor vLLM-specific recovery
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned provider-specific recovery design if exact reproduction is impractical, with security review and false-promotion tests.

options.title: Treat docs workaround as enough
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the vLLM tool_choice/server-parser workaround is the supported answer for this deployment class.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest direct current-main history in the OpenAI-compatible reasoning/tool-call parser path.
